results.question: what does 'up to 50 days interest free' actually mean? do I get 50 days on everything I buy with the credit card?
results.answer:

To get the interest-free period, you must pay your full statement balance by the payment due date. It does not apply to cash advances.

The app shows your statement date and payment due date, so you can check when a purchase will fall due.

results.question: what happens if i miss one instalment on my personal loan
results.answer:

- A late payment fee of KES 500 is charged for each missed instalment. It is charged once for that instalment, however long the instalment stays unpaid.
- Interest continues at your loan rate on what you owe. We do not charge a higher rate.
- We try to collect the missed amount again when money next comes into your Kaskazi Everyday Account.
- Missed instalments are recorded on your loan and are reported to credit reference bureaus. A missed instalment can make it harder for you to borrow in future, from us or anyone else.

If you know you'll be late, tell us before the instalment date. We cannot always waive the fee, but we can often agree a plan that avoids further missed payments. Would you like me to check your loan's next due date or your account balance?

results.question: how much is the monthly fee on everyday account? and can i avoid paying it
results.answer:
The Everyday Account has a monthly fee of KES 250. You can avoid it in either of two ways:

- Your salary is paid in that month. The KES 250 monthly fee is waived for any month in which your salary is paid into your Kaskazi Everyday Account.
- Your average balance is high enough. The KES 250 monthly fee on the Kaskazi Everyday Account is also waived for any month in which your average balance is KES 50,000 or more. The balance can fall below KES 50,000 on some days and you can still qualify, as long as the average for the whole month is KES 50,000 or more.

Meeting either condition is enough. If you are self-employed or paid in cash, you won't qualify for the salary waiver, but you can still use the average balance waiver.

results.question: how is the personal loan interest worked out, is it linked to the base rate?

results.question: Is there a monthly fee on the Everyday Account?
results.answer:
Yes. The Kaskazi Everyday Account has a monthly fee of KES 250. You don't pay it in any month when your salary is paid into the account that month, or your average balance for the month is KES 50,000 or more. Only one condition needs to be met.

Your Everyday Account balance is currently KES 41,230, below that KES 50,000 test. Because the test uses your average balance across the month, a salary paid into the account is the simpler route to a waiver.
